title: Studio Suite with private entrance in Nashville
description:
Spacious, clean Studio Suite with your own private entrance, deck,  & driveway. A full bathroom with large shower, mini-fridge, microwave & coffee maker, you'll feel like you found a home away from home here in Nashville.

Located in a quiet neighborhood in S.E. Nashville, you're only a quick 15 minutes away from downtown & the action on Broadway Street.

Comfortable King bed & rollaway bed & air mattress suitable for 3 people max.

Relax in our backyard! There's a fire pit & grill available.

Other things to note
No parties. Not suitable for children. No pets.
